title: lycopodioides sanguinolenta
intro: Lycopodioides sanguinolenta, commonly known as "red-stemmed club moss," is a type of vascular plant belonging to the lycopodiopsida class. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodioides sanguinolenta include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its use in treating skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various terpenoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
